blocks.zh: 一次性使用元件與最終容器 ｜ 風險導向供應商資格審查
blocks.en: Single-Use Components and Final Containers | Risk-Based Supplier Qualification

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ATMP 一次性使用元件 (Single-Use Components) 與最終容器 (Final Containers) 的特殊選用考量，包含冷凍保存袋、玻璃瓶、預充填注射器的差異。
blocks.en: Understand the particular selection considerations for ATMP single-use components and final containers, including the differences between cryopreservation bags, glass vials and prefilled syringes.

blocks.zh: 掌握可萃取物與可滲出物 (Extractables & Leachables, E&L) 對活細胞產品之獨特風險：滲出物可能直接影響細胞活性 (Cell Viability)，遠比小分子藥物更敏感。
blocks.en: Master the unique risk that extractables & leachables (E&L) pose to live-cell products: leachables can directly affect cell viability, making these products far more sensitive than small-molecule drugs.

blocks.zh: 能夠應用風險分層 (Risk Tiering) 原則，將供應商分為 Tier 1/2/3，依物料關鍵性決定稽核策略（現場稽核、書面稽核或技術訪視）。
blocks.en: Be able to apply risk tiering principles to classify suppliers into Tier 1/2/3 and decide the audit strategy (on-site audit, paper audit or technical visit) according to material criticality.

blocks.zh: 了解針對學術源頭或 GMP 體系不成熟供應商的管理策略，以及單一供應商 (Single-Source Supplier) 的風險緩解措施。
blocks.en: Understand management strategies for suppliers of academic origin or with an immature GMP system, and risk mitigation measures for a single-source supplier.

blocks.zh: 掌握 PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.27 對個人化療法 (Individualized/Autologous Therapies) 供應鏈資訊傳遞的特殊要求。
blocks.en: Master the special requirements of PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.27 for passing on supply chain information in individualized/autologous therapies.

blocks.en: Q3.3 — Specific Considerations for ATMP Single-Use Components and Final Containers (PtC-13 p22)

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 一次性使用元件的 ATMP 特殊性
blocks.en: Core Concept — What Makes Single-Use Components Special in ATMPs

blocks.zh: Single-Use Component (一次性使用元件): 在 ATMP 製造中，一次性使用元件不只是方便性工具，而是產品品質與患者安全的直接屏障。與傳統小分子藥物不同，ATMP 的最終容器（特別是細胞治療的冷凍保存袋）在整個生命週期中都與活細胞直接接觸。
blocks.en: Single-Use Component: In ATMP manufacturing, single-use components are not merely a convenience; they are a direct barrier for product quality and patient safety. Unlike traditional small-molecule drugs, the final container of an ATMP (especially the cryopreservation bag of a cell therapy) is in direct contact with live cells throughout its entire lifecycle.

blocks.zh: Container-Closure System (容器密封系統): ATMP 的容器密封系統選擇必須同時考慮：
blocks.en: Container-Closure System: The choice of an ATMP container-closure system must take into account all of the following:

blocks.zh: 物理完整性：在 −196°C 液氮到 37°C 解凍之間的溫度劇變中維持密封
blocks.en: Physical integrity: Maintaining the seal through the extreme temperature swing from −196°C liquid nitrogen to 37°C thawing

blocks.zh: 化學相容性：與 DMSO（常用冷凍保護劑，濃度可達 5–10%）長時間接觸
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility: Prolonged contact with DMSO (a common cryoprotectant, at concentrations up to 5–10%)

blocks.zh: 生物相容性：不得釋出影響細胞活性的滲出物
blocks.en: Biocompatibility: No release of leachables that affect cell viability

blocks.zh: Traceability (可追溯性): 對自體細胞治療而言，每一個容器都對應一個特定患者，供應鏈的完整可追溯性是「不可妥協的底線」，而非一般 GMP 好做法。
blocks.en: Traceability: For autologous cell therapy, every container corresponds to one specific patient, so complete traceability of the supply chain is a "non-negotiable baseline", not just a general GMP good practice.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 細胞治療袋 vs 玻璃瓶的選擇
blocks.en: Analogy — Choosing between a Cell Therapy Bag and a Glass Vial

blocks.zh: 想像你要運送一批活的熱帶魚（活細胞）跨洲越洋。你的容器選擇決定了魚能否存活到目的地：
blocks.en: Imagine shipping live tropical fish (live cells) across continents and oceans. Your choice of container decides whether the fish survive to the destination:

blocks.zh: 冷凍保存袋就像特製的保溫運魚袋——柔軟有彈性、可以在極低溫中壓縮而不破裂，但需確認袋材不會釋放毒素到水中（E&L 問題）。
blocks.en: A cryopreservation bag is like a specially insulated fish transport bag: soft and flexible, able to be compressed at very low temperatures without cracking, but you need to confirm the bag material does not release toxins into the water (the E&L issue).

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶就像堅固的玻璃魚缸——化學性質穩定，但在急凍急解時可能因熱脹冷縮而出現微裂縫（CCI 問題）。
blocks.en: A glass vial is like a sturdy glass aquarium: chemically stable, but under rapid freezing and thawing it may develop microcracks from thermal expansion and contraction (the CCI issue).

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器就像注射器式的精準給藥工具——適合直接到患者，但針管內的矽油 (Silicone Oil) 可能影響細胞功能。
blocks.en: A prefilled syringe is like a precision syringe-style dosing tool: well suited to direct delivery to the patient, but the silicone oil in the barrel may affect cell function.

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷：「這個容器在整個冷鏈旅程（從製造廠到患者手術室）中，能讓我的細胞保持活性嗎？」
blocks.en: The key question: "Will this container keep my cells viable throughout the entire cold chain journey (from the manufacturing site to the patient's operating room)?"

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — E&L 對活細胞的獨特威脅
blocks.en: Key Point — The Unique Threat of E&L to Live Cells

blocks.zh: 傳統 E&L 研究（例如依據 USP <661>、ISO 10993）主要評估對患者安全的化學毒性。然而，對於細胞治療產品，E&L 有一個額外的維度：對細胞活性 (Cell Viability) 的直接影響。
blocks.en: Traditional E&L studies (for example under USP <661> and ISO 10993) mainly assess chemical toxicity to patient safety. For cell therapy products, however, E&L has an additional dimension: the direct effect on cell viability.

blocks.zh: 即使某個滲出物的濃度低到對人體無毒，它仍可能在製造過程中造成：
blocks.en: Even if the concentration of a leachable is low enough to be non-toxic to humans, it can still cause the following during manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 細胞死亡率上升（活性 < 70% 可能導致批次報廢）
blocks.en: Increased cell death (viability < 70% may lead to batch rejection)

blocks.zh: T 細胞或 NK 細胞的功能性下降（CAR-T 擴增效率降低）
blocks.en: Reduced function of T cells or NK cells (lower CAR-T expansion efficiency)

blocks.zh: 幹細胞分化方向改變（誘導多能幹細胞 iPSC 的異常分化）
blocks.en: Altered stem cell differentiation (abnormal differentiation of induced pluripotent stem cells, iPSC)

blocks.zh: 實務上：在容器材料選型初期，就應進行細胞相容性測試 (Cell Compatibility Study)，而不是等到 E&L 化學分析完成才回頭確認對細胞的影響。兩者應並行進行。
blocks.en: In practice: a Cell Compatibility Study should be performed at the very start of container material selection, rather than waiting for the E&L chemical analysis to finish before checking the effect on cells. The two should run in parallel.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 容器選型決策框架
blocks.en: Practical Application — A Container Selection Decision Framework for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 當客戶帶著一個新的 ATMP 細胞治療產品來諮詢容器選擇時，建議以下決策流程：
blocks.en: When a client comes with a new ATMP cell therapy product and asks for advice on container selection, we recommend the following decision flow:

blocks.zh: 產品型態：最終產品是懸浮細胞？凍乾粉末？液態製劑？ → 決定容器格式（袋/瓶/注射器）
blocks.en: Product form: Is the final product a cell suspension? A lyophilized powder? A liquid formulation? → determines the container format (bag/vial/syringe)

blocks.zh: 儲存條件：需要冷凍至 −80°C 或液氮（−196°C）？還是冷藏 2–8°C？ → 決定材料耐溫規格
blocks.en: Storage conditions: Does it need to be frozen at −80°C or in liquid nitrogen (−196°C), or refrigerated at 2–8°C? → determines the temperature resistance specification of the material

blocks.zh: 配方特性：含 DMSO？含特殊緩衝液或蛋白質？ → 決定 E&L 測試的優先溶劑
blocks.en: Formulation characteristics: Does it contain DMSO? Special buffers or proteins? → determines the priority solvents for E&L testing

blocks.zh: 給藥途徑：靜脈輸注？直接注射到腫瘤部位？ → 決定無菌保證等級要求
blocks.en: Route of administration: Intravenous infusion? Direct injection into the tumor site? → determines the required sterility assurance level

blocks.zh: 法規市場：EU（EMA）、US（FDA）、日本（PMDA）？ → 決定適用的 CCI 測試標準
blocks.en: Regulatory market: EU (EMA), US (FDA), Japan (PMDA)? → determines the applicable CCI test standards

blocks.zh: 將上述答案對應到「容器材料需求規格書」，才能有意義地進行供應商詢價與資格審查。
blocks.en: Only by mapping the answers above onto a "container material requirements specification" can supplier inquiries and qualification be carried out meaningfully.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 CAR-T 細胞治療產品需要在 −196°C 液氮中長期保存，並以 DMSO 作為冷凍保護劑。請問在選擇最終容器時，你需要評估哪些關鍵風險？請列出至少三項。
blocks.en: A CAR-T cell therapy product needs long-term storage in −196°C liquid nitrogen with DMSO as the cryoprotectant. What key risks do you need to evaluate when selecting the final container? List at least three.

blocks.zh: 為什麼對於自體細胞治療（Autologous Cell Therapy），容器的可追溯性要求比異體細胞治療（Allogeneic Cell Therapy）更為嚴格？
blocks.en: Why are the traceability requirements for containers stricter for autologous cell therapy than for allogeneic cell therapy?

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.27 要求供應商在供貨後若發現新的健康捐贈者資訊，應通知 ATMP 製造商。請問這個要求在實務上如何透過「供應商品質協議」(Supplier Quality Agreement) 落實？
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.27 requires the supplier to notify the ATMP manufacturer if new donor health information is found after supply. How can this requirement be put into practice through a Supplier Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: Topic 4 — Risk-Based Supplier Qualification: Overview PtC-13 p23 Topic 4 — 基於風险評估的供應商確效：概述（PtC-13 p23）
blocks.en: Topic 4 — Risk-Based Supplier Qualification: Overview (PtC-13 p23)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 供應商風險分層模型
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Supplier Risk Tiering Model

blocks.zh: PtC-13 的供應商資格審查哲學核心是：「監管力道與物料風險成正比」。這在實務上轉化為供應商分層 (Supplier Tiering)：
blocks.en: The core philosophy of supplier qualification in PtC-13 is that "the intensity of oversight is proportional to the risk of the material". In practice this translates into Supplier Tiering:

blocks.zh: Tier 1（關鍵物料供應商）：直接接觸產品、影響最終產品安全性的物料（例：冷凍保存袋、細胞擴增培養基、病毒載體）→ 必須進行現場稽核 (On-Site Audit) + 書面品質協議。
blocks.en: Tier 1 (critical material suppliers): Materials in direct contact with the product that affect the safety of the final product (for example cryopreservation bags, cell expansion media, viral vectors) → an on-site audit plus a written quality agreement are required.

blocks.zh: Tier 2（重要物料供應商）：間接影響產品品質，但不直接接觸最終產品（例：GMP 等級細胞因子、關鍵試劑）→ 書面稽核（問卷）+ 變更通知協議即可。
blocks.en: Tier 2 (important material suppliers): Materials that affect product quality indirectly but do not contact the final product directly (for example GMP-grade cytokines, key reagents) → a paper audit (questionnaire) plus a change notification agreement is sufficient.

blocks.zh: Tier 3（一般物料供應商）：低風險、可替換、市售現成品（例：標準實驗耗材）→ 供應商選擇記錄 + CoA 即可。
blocks.en: Tier 3 (general material suppliers): Low-risk, replaceable, commercially available off-the-shelf items (for example standard laboratory consumables) → a supplier selection record plus the CoA is sufficient.

blocks.zh: 分層依據：物料的生物來源風險、接觸時間與溫度、不可替代性、GMP 符合程度。
blocks.en: Basis for tiering: biological source risk of the material, contact time and temperature, irreplaceability and degree of GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 像連鎖餐廳管理供應商一樣
blocks.en: Analogy — Managing Suppliers Like a Restaurant Chain

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家頂級連鎖餐廳的品質總監，你的食材供應商就是 ATMP 的物料供應商：
blocks.en: Imagine you are the quality director of a top restaurant chain, and your food suppliers are the ATMP material suppliers:

blocks.zh: 松露供應商（Tier 1，關鍵物料）：每季親自拜訪農場，確認採收、保鮮、運輸全程 — 就像現場稽核 (On-Site Audit)。
blocks.en: Truffle supplier (Tier 1, critical material): You visit the farm in person every quarter to confirm harvesting, preservation and transport end to end - just like an On-Site Audit.

blocks.zh: 有機蔬菜供應商（Tier 2，重要物料）：每年寄送問卷確認有機認證仍有效，不需親自到場 — 就像書面稽核 (Paper Audit)。
blocks.en: Organic vegetable supplier (Tier 2, important material): You send a questionnaire every year to confirm the organic certification is still valid, with no need to visit in person - just like a Paper Audit.

blocks.zh: 工業用鹽供應商（Tier 3，一般物料）：只確認每批符合食品安全標準規格即可 — 就像 CoA 查核。
blocks.en: Industrial salt supplier (Tier 3, general material): You only confirm that each lot meets the food safety specification - just like a CoA check.

blocks.zh: 當你發現松露供應商換了農場（等同供應商的重大變更 Change Notification），你一定希望第一時間被告知，而不是收貨後才發現品質異常。這就是「書面變更通知協議」(Written Change Notification Agreement) 的核心價值。
blocks.en: If the truffle supplier switches farms (the equivalent of a major supplier change, or Change Notification), you will certainly want to be told right away, rather than discovering a quality problem after receiving the goods. That is the core value of a "Written Change Notification Agreement".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — "GMP Grade" 不等於真正的 GMP
blocks.en: Key Point — "GMP Grade" Does Not Mean Real GMP

blocks.zh: PtC-13 特別點出一個在 ATMP 產業非常普遍的誤解：供應商標榜「GMP Grade」物料，不代表其製造過程符合 cGMP 法規。
blocks.en: PtC-13 specifically points out a misconception that is very common in the ATMP industry: a supplier advertising a material as "GMP Grade" does not mean its manufacturing process complies with cGMP regulations.

blocks.zh: 實務上常見的情況：
blocks.en: Common situations in practice:

blocks.zh: 供應商在型錄上印「GMP Grade」，但這只是自我聲稱，沒有第三方稽核驗證。
blocks.en: The supplier prints "GMP Grade" in the catalog, but this is only a self-declared claim with no third-party audit verification.

blocks.zh: 真正的 GMP 符合性需透過問卷評估或現場稽核來驗證。
blocks.en: True GMP compliance has to be verified through a questionnaire assessment or an on-site audit.

blocks.zh: 如果你在稽核中發現供應商無法提供批次製造記錄 (Batch Manufacturing Record)，這是重大缺失——不論其型錄上寫了什麼等級。
blocks.en: If an audit finds the supplier cannot provide Batch Manufacturing Records, this is a major deficiency, regardless of the grade stated in its catalog.

blocks.zh: 行動建議：CDMO 的供應商批准清單 (Approved Supplier List, ASL) 應記錄每個物料的「GMP 等級聲稱依據」及「實際驗證方法」，避免單憑型錄定級。
blocks.en: Recommended action: the CDMO's Approved Supplier List (ASL) should record, for each material, the "basis for the GMP grade claim" and the "actual verification method", to avoid assigning a grade on the catalog alone.

blocks.zh: 供應商風險評分框架 Supplier Risk Scoring
blocks.en: Supplier Risk Scoring

blocks.zh:
供應商風險評分 =
  物料關鍵性評分 (1–5)
  × 供應商 GMP 成熟度 (1–5，5 = 無認證)
  × 供應來源風險 (1–5，5 = 動物源)
  ÷ 可替代性 (1–5，1 = 易替換)

風險分層：
  低風險 (≤ 10)  → Tier 3 → CoA + 變更通知
  中風險 (11–25) → Tier 2 → 書面稽核 + 品質協議
  高風險 (> 25)  → Tier 1 → 現場稽核 + 完整 SQA

範例：
  冷凍保存袋 = 5 × 2 × 2 ÷ 1 = 20 → Tier 2/1 邊界
  人源血清白蛋白 = 5 × 3 × 5 ÷ 2 = 37.5 → Tier 1
  標準培養皿 = 1 × 2 × 1 ÷ 5 = 0.4 → Tier 3
blocks.en:
Supplier risk score =
  Material criticality score (1–5)
  × Supplier GMP maturity (1–5, 5 = no certification)
  × Supply source risk (1–5, 5 = animal origin)
  ÷ Replaceability (1–5, 1 = easily replaced)

Risk tiers:
  Low risk (≤ 10)     → Tier 3 → CoA + change notification
  Medium risk (11–25) → Tier 2 → paper audit + quality agreement
  High risk (> 25)    → Tier 1 → on-site audit + full SQA

Examples:
  Cryopreservation bag = 5 × 2 × 2 ÷ 1 = 20 → Tier 2/1 boundary
  Human serum albumin = 5 × 3 × 5 ÷ 2 = 37.5 → Tier 1
  Standard culture dish = 1 × 2 × 1 ÷ 5 = 0.4 → Tier 3

blocks.zh: 一家小型學術衍生公司（Academic Spin-off）提供你一種 ATMP 製造用的客製化細胞培養基（Custom Cell Culture Medium），但他們的 GMP 體系尚不成熟，不接受外部稽核。PtC-13 建議你採取什麼替代措施？此措施的局限性是什麼？
blocks.en: A small academic spin-off offers you a custom cell culture medium for ATMP manufacturing, but its GMP system is not yet mature and it does not accept external audits. What alternative measures does PtC-13 suggest, and what are the limitations of those measures?

blocks.zh: 你的某個關鍵細胞因子供應商（Tier 1）通知你，他們即將更換原料蛋白質的表達系統。根據 PtC-13 的指引，你應該要求供應商提供哪些文件，以評估這個變更對你的 ATMP 製造的影響？
blocks.en: One of your critical cytokine suppliers (Tier 1) notifies you that it is about to change the expression system of the raw protein. According to PtC-13, what documents should you ask the supplier to provide in order to assess the impact of this change on your ATMP manufacturing?

blocks.zh: 一個美國已獲 FDA 許可上市的治療性蛋白質產品，你需要將其用作 ATMP 的輔助材料。PtC-13 說此情況可以如何簡化供應商資格審查？
blocks.en: A therapeutic protein product already licensed by FDA in the US is to be used as an ancillary material in an ATMP. How does PtC-13 say supplier qualification can be simplified in this case?

blocks.zh: Q4.1 (continued) — Early Clinical Stage Requirements PtC-13 p24 Q4.1（續）— 早期臨床階段要求（PtC-13 p24）
blocks.en: Q4.1 (continued) — Early Clinical Stage Requirements (PtC-13 p24)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 早期臨床階段供應商最低要求
blocks.en: Core Concept — Minimum Supplier Requirements in the Early Clinical Stage

blocks.zh: 在 Phase 1 臨床試驗申請（IND/IMPD）階段，PtC-13 採取了「最低但可行」的務實立場。以下是三類物料的差異化要求：
blocks.en: At the Phase 1 clinical trial application (IND/IMPD) stage, PtC-13 takes a pragmatic "minimum but workable" position. The requirements differ for three categories of material:

blocks.zh: 客製化物料（Custom Materials）：例如客製化病毒載體、特製培養基 → 必須有書面品質協議 (Quality Agreement)，因為這些物料具有獨特性，無法被其他供應商直接替換。
blocks.en: Custom Materials: For example custom viral vectors or special media → a written Quality Agreement is required, because these materials are unique and cannot simply be replaced by another supplier.

blocks.zh: 關鍵現成品（Critical Off-the-Shelf）：例如特定廠牌的細胞因子 → 至少要有「變更通知協議 (Change Notification Agreement)」——當供應商改變配方或生產地點時，你必須第一時間知道。
blocks.en: Critical Off-the-Shelf: For example a cytokine of a specific brand → at least a "Change Notification Agreement" is needed, so that you know right away when the supplier changes the formulation or manufacturing site.

blocks.zh: 低風險現成品（Low-Risk Off-the-Shelf）：例如實驗室標準試劑 → 型錄號碼 + CoA 即可，暫時不需要正式協議。
blocks.en: Low-Risk Off-the-Shelf: For example standard laboratory reagents → catalog number plus CoA is enough, with no formal agreement needed for the time being.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：臨床進展就是「資格審查升級」的觸發點。Phase 1 → Phase 3 的路途上，每個關卡都需重新評估供應商的資格等級。
blocks.en: Key principle: clinical progression is the trigger for "upgrading qualification". On the road from Phase 1 to Phase 3, the qualification level of each supplier must be reassessed at every milestone.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 管理學術源頭供應商
blocks.en: Analogy — Managing Academic-Origin Suppliers

blocks.zh: ATMP 產業有很多供應商是「學術衍生公司」(Academic Spin-off)——他們的技術往往是世界最先進的，但 GMP 體系可能剛起步，就像一個剛從學校畢業的天才工程師：腦袋裡有最新的知識，但還不熟悉工廠的 SOP 規範。
blocks.en: Many suppliers in the ATMP industry are academic spin-offs. Their technology is often the most advanced in the world, but their GMP system may only be starting out, like a brilliant engineer fresh out of school: head full of the latest knowledge, but not yet familiar with factory SOPs.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在此扮演的角色就像一位有耐心的前輩：
blocks.en: The role of the CDMO here is like a patient senior colleague:

blocks.zh: 第一步：協助他們建立基本文件系統（材料追溯、批次號管理）
blocks.en: Step 1: Help them build a basic documentation system (material traceability, lot number management)

blocks.zh: 第二步：要求簽訂變更通知協議（讓他們養成「有變動要通報」的習慣）
blocks.en: Step 2: Ask them to sign a change notification agreement (so they form the habit of "report any change")

blocks.zh: 第三步：提供 GMP 要求的培訓，等他們能力成熟後，再升級為正式品質協議
blocks.en: Step 3: Provide training on GMP requirements, and upgrade to a formal quality agreement once their capability matures

blocks.zh: 這個策略在 PtC-13 中被稱為「phase-appropriate supplier development」——你不需要等到供應商完全成熟才開始合作，但每個階段都必須有對應的管控措施。
blocks.en: This strategy is called "phase-appropriate supplier development" in PtC-13: you do not need to wait until the supplier is fully mature to start working together, but appropriate controls must be in place at every stage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 變更通知協議是最重要的第一步
blocks.en: Key Point — The Change Notification Agreement Is the Most Important First Step

blocks.zh: 在所有供應商協議中，變更通知協議 (Change Notification Agreement) 是最快應該建立的，因為它的目的是「防止你在不知情的情況下使用了不同品質的物料」。
blocks.en: Of all supplier agreements, the Change Notification Agreement is the one to put in place soonest, because its purpose is to "prevent you from unknowingly using a material of different quality".

blocks.zh: 以下是常見的供應商變更場景及其對 ATMP 的潛在影響：
blocks.en: Common supplier change scenarios and their potential impact on ATMPs:

blocks.zh: 培養基配方調整（細胞擴增效率改變）
blocks.en: Adjustment of the medium formulation (change in cell expansion efficiency)

blocks.zh: 生產廠房搬遷（環境監控標準可能不同）
blocks.en: Relocation of the manufacturing site (environmental monitoring standards may differ)

blocks.zh: 原料來源地改變（動物源風險，TSE/BSE 問題）
blocks.en: Change in raw material source (animal-origin risk, TSE/BSE issues)

blocks.zh: 保存劑種類改變（E&L 風險改變）
blocks.en: Change in the type of preservative (E&L risk changes)

blocks.zh: 即使在 Phase 1 階段，缺少變更通知協議可能導致：使用了已悄悄改版的物料，而兩批毒理學研究與 Phase 1 臨床試驗用料之間出現批次不一致，引發 FDA/EMA 的審查問題。
blocks.en: Even in Phase 1, the lack of a change notification agreement can result in using a material that has quietly been revised, causing lot inconsistency between the material used in the toxicology studies and in the Phase 1 clinical trial, and raising questions in FDA/EMA review.

blocks.zh: Q4.1 (continued) — Late Clinical Stage & Commercial: Single-Source Risk Mitigation PtC-13 p24–p25 Q4.1（續）— 後期臨床階段與商業化：單一來源風险降低措施（PtC-13 p24–p25）
blocks.en: Q4.1 (continued) — Late Clinical Stage & Commercial: Single-Source Risk Mitigation (PtC-13 p24–p25)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 晚期臨床與商業化階段的供應商升級要求
blocks.en: Core Concept — Supplier Upgrade Requirements in the Late Clinical and Commercial Stages

blocks.zh: Phase 2/3（確認性或樞紐試驗，Confirmatory/Pivotal Clinical Trial）是供應商管理的重大轉折點。此時：
blocks.en: Phase 2/3 (Confirmatory/Pivotal Clinical Trial) is a major turning point in supplier management. At this point:

blocks.zh: 批次失敗不只是損失研究物料，而是直接影響患者入組進度、試驗時間表，以及數億美元的臨床投資。
blocks.en: A lot failure is not just a loss of research material; it directly affects patient enrollment progress, the trial timeline and a clinical investment of hundreds of millions of dollars.

blocks.zh: 商業化後的物料短缺 (Drug Shortage) 可能直接影響等待治療的患者，觸發監管機構的緊急調查。
blocks.en: After commercialization, a material shortage (Drug Shortage) can directly affect patients waiting for treatment and trigger an emergency investigation by the regulator.

blocks.zh: 監管申報（BLA/MAA）要求供應商資訊有更高的透明度與一致性，包括物料規格、品質協議內容、稽核頻率等。
blocks.en: Regulatory filings (BLA/MAA) require greater transparency and consistency of supplier information, including material specifications, the content of quality agreements and audit frequency.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 PtC-13 在此階段特別強調「第二供應商」——不是因為法規強制要求，而是因為沒有備援的後果實在太嚴重。
blocks.en: This is why PtC-13 particularly emphasizes a "second supplier" at this stage: not because regulations mandate it, but because the consequences of having no backup are simply too serious.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 單一供應商風險就像沒有備用輪胎
blocks.en: Analogy — Single-Supplier Risk Is Like Having No Spare Tire

blocks.zh: 在 F1 賽車比賽中，如果你的唯一輪胎供應商在決賽前一天無法出貨，你只能棄賽——不論你的車有多快。對於 ATMP 商業化產品，單一關鍵物料供應商就是這個單點故障。
blocks.en: In a Formula 1 race, if your only tire supplier cannot ship the day before the final, you have to withdraw, no matter how fast your car is. For a commercial ATMP product, a single critical material supplier is exactly this single point of failure.

blocks.zh: 緩解策略的類比：
blocks.en: Analogy for the mitigation strategies:

blocks.zh: 備胎（Safety Stock）：提前備貨，計算合理的安全庫存量（考慮物料效期 vs. 進貨前置時間）。
blocks.en: Spare tires (Safety Stock): Stock up in advance and calculate a reasonable safety stock level (considering material shelf life vs. lead time for receipt).

blocks.zh: 備用車隊（Second Qualified Supplier）：提前資格審查第二個供應商，即使平時不用，危急時可以立即切換。
blocks.en: A backup fleet (Second Qualified Supplier): Qualify a second supplier in advance, so that even if it is not used day to day, you can switch immediately in a crisis.

blocks.zh: 車隊保險（Business Continuity Plan）：書面記錄當主供應商停產時的應對流程，包含監管機構通知流程。
blocks.en: Fleet insurance (Business Continuity Plan): Document in writing the response process for when the main supplier stops production, including the process for notifying regulators.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的商業考量：建立第二供應商需要額外投入資格審查的時間（3–12 個月）與成本，但與商業化後物料斷貨的損失相比，這是值得的投資。
blocks.en: CDMO commercial consideration: setting up a second supplier takes extra time (3–12 months) and cost for qualification, but compared with the loss from a material stock-out after commercialization, it is a worthwhile investment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 決策層級的優先順序
blocks.en: Key Point — Priority Order at the Decision Level

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌保證 Sterility Assurance
blocks.en: 1. Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: 2. 產品關鍵品質屬性 CQAs (患者安全)
blocks.en: 2. Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) of the product (patient safety)

blocks.zh: 3. 商業連續性 Business Continuity
blocks.en: 3. Business Continuity

blocks.zh: 在評估是否接受「有 GMP 缺口」的單一供應商時，這個層級至關重要：如果接受該供應商的缺口會危及無菌保證（Level 1），則無論業務壓力多大，都不應接受——直到缺口被修正。
blocks.en: This hierarchy is critical when assessing whether to accept a single-source supplier with GMP gaps: if accepting the supplier's gaps would endanger sterility assurance (Level 1), it should not be accepted, however great the business pressure, until the gaps are corrected.

blocks.zh: 實務情境：當你的唯一冷凍保存袋供應商無法提供無菌測試記錄時（涉及 Level 1 風險），CDMO 必須暫停物料接收並通知客戶，即使這可能延誤患者治療時程。患者安全永遠優先於時程壓力。
blocks.en: Practical scenario: when your only cryopreservation bag supplier cannot provide sterility test records (a Level 1 risk), the CDMO must suspend receipt of the material and notify the client, even if this may delay the patient's treatment schedule. Patient safety always takes priority over schedule pressure.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 供應商品質協議 (Supplier Quality Agreement, SQA) 核心條款
blocks.en: Practical Application — Core Clauses of a Supplier Quality Agreement (SQA)

blocks.zh: 一份完整的 SQA 對 ATMP 關鍵物料供應商應涵蓋以下核心條款：
blocks.en: A complete SQA for an ATMP critical material supplier should cover the following core clauses:

blocks.zh: 物料規格：雙方認可的技術規格書 (Technical Specification)
blocks.en: Material specification: A technical specification agreed by both parties

blocks.zh: 測試責任：供應商責任測試 vs. 廠內入廠測試的分工
blocks.en: Testing responsibilities: The split between testing done by the supplier and incoming testing on site

blocks.zh: 變更管理：供應商啟動變更前的通知期（建議：重大變更至少提前 6 個月通知）
blocks.en: Change management: The notice period before the supplier initiates a change (recommended: at least 6 months' notice for major changes)

blocks.zh: 批次記錄：每批應提供的文件（CoA、CoC、批製造記錄摘要）
blocks.en: Batch records: The documents to be provided with each lot (CoA, CoC, batch manufacturing record summary)

blocks.zh: 稽核權限：廠方的現場稽核頻率與預先通知時間
blocks.en: Audit rights: The frequency of on-site audits by the purchaser and the advance notice time

blocks.zh: 不符合品管理：OOS 批次的處理流程與 CAPA 通知義務
blocks.en: Nonconformance management: The handling process for OOS lots and the CAPA notification obligation

blocks.zh: 供應鏈資訊：（人源物料特別條款）PIC/S 5.27 要求的捐贈者健康資訊傳遞機制
blocks.en: Supply chain information: (special clause for human-derived materials) The mechanism for passing on donor health information required by PIC/S 5.27

blocks.zh: 你的 CAR-T 療法的唯一關鍵細胞因子供應商（單一供應商，進貨前置時間 4 個月）宣布將在 6 個月後停止生產。請根據 PtC-13 的指引，制定一份緊急應對計畫，並列出需通知監管機構的時機與方式。
blocks.en: The sole critical cytokine supplier for your CAR-T therapy (single source, 4-month lead time) announces it will stop production in 6 months. Based on PtC-13, draw up an emergency response plan and list when and how regulators need to be notified.

blocks.zh: 在商業化申請（BLA/MAA）階段，監管機構審查員發現你的 IND/IMPD 中所列的關鍵培養基供應商從未接受過現場稽核，只有問卷紀錄。這是否符合 PtC-13 的指引？你需要補充哪些文件或行動？
blocks.en: At the commercial application (BLA/MAA) stage, a regulatory reviewer finds that the critical medium supplier listed in your IND/IMPD has never had an on-site audit, only questionnaire records. Does this comply with PtC-13? What documents or actions do you need to add?

blocks.zh: 一個早期臨床階段（Phase 1）的 ATMP 廠商，因人力資源有限，準備將所有供應商一律處理為 Tier 3（僅 CoA 查核）。根據 PtC-13 的風險導向原則，這樣的做法有哪些缺失？請舉出至少兩種物料說明應升級至更高層級的理由。
blocks.en: An early clinical stage (Phase 1) ATMP company, with limited staff, plans to treat all suppliers as Tier 3 (CoA check only). Under the risk-based principles of PtC-13, what is wrong with this approach? Give at least two materials that should be upgraded to a higher tier and explain why.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — PtC-13 Section 3b & Topic 4 Q4.1
blocks.en: Section Summary — PtC-13 Section 3b & Topic 4 Q4.1

blocks.zh: Q3.3 一次性使用元件：ATMP 容器密封系統的選擇需同時評估物理完整性（低溫 CCI）、化學相容性（DMSO 等冷凍保護劑）、以及生物相容性（E&L 對活細胞的影響）——三者缺一不可，且 E&L 評估必須包含細胞相容性測試，不能只做化學安全分析。
blocks.en: Q3.3 Single-use components: Selection of an ATMP container-closure system must evaluate physical integrity (cryogenic CCI), chemical compatibility (cryoprotectants such as DMSO) and biocompatibility (the effect of E&L on live cells). All three are indispensable, and the E&L assessment must include cell compatibility testing, not only chemical safety analysis.

blocks.zh: 無菌保證的特殊性：許多 ATMP 物料供應商無法保證符合藥典等級的無菌性；主要容器密封系統的入廠測試最低應包含無菌性、完整性（CCI）、細菌內毒素三項。
blocks.en: The special nature of sterility assurance: Many ATMP material suppliers cannot guarantee sterility at pharmacopoeial level; incoming testing of the primary container-closure system should include at least sterility, integrity (CCI) and bacterial endotoxin.

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 2A 5.27 要求：人源起始物料的供應協議必須包含捐贈者健康資訊的回溯傳遞條款——即使是供貨後才發現的健康相關資訊，供應商也有義務通知 ATMP 製造商。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 2A 5.27 requirement: Supply agreements for human-derived starting materials must include a clause for retrospective passing on of donor health information: even for health-related information found after supply, the supplier is obliged to notify the ATMP manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 風險分層供應商管理：供應商稽核策略（現場稽核 vs. 書面稽核 vs. 技術訪視）應依物料關鍵性和供應商 GMP 成熟度來決定，而非一刀切。早期臨床可接受較低標準，但必須隨臨床進展逐步升級。
blocks.en: Risk-tiered supplier management: The supplier audit strategy (on-site audit vs. paper audit vs. technical visit) should be decided by material criticality and supplier GMP maturity, not one-size-fits-all. A lower standard is acceptable in early clinical stages but must be upgraded step by step as clinical development progresses.

blocks.zh: "GMP Grade" 標籤的誤解：供應商型錄上的 GMP Grade 標示不代表真實的 cGMP 符合性，必須通過問卷評估或現場稽核加以驗證。
blocks.en: The "GMP Grade" label misconception: A GMP Grade label in a supplier catalog does not indicate true cGMP compliance; it must be verified through a questionnaire assessment or an on-site audit.

blocks.zh: 單一供應商風險：晚期臨床與商業化階段，關鍵物料的第二供應商資格審查是必要的風險管理措施，而非可選項——物料斷貨對 ATMP 患者的衝擊遠超一般藥品。
blocks.en: Single-source supplier risk: In the late clinical and commercial stages, qualifying a second supplier for critical materials is a necessary risk management measure, not an option, because a material stock-out affects ATMP patients far more than patients on ordinary drugs.
